views.name: public.published_reviews
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    specialist_id,
    body,
    would_hire_again,
    created_at
   FROM reviews
  WHERE is_published = true;

views.name: public.published_specialist_trust_badges
views.definition:
SELECT assignment.id,
    assignment.specialist_id,
    assignment.badge_id,
    assignment.source,
    assignment.assigned_at
   FROM specialist_trust_badges assignment
     JOIN specialists specialist ON specialist.id = assignment.specialist_id
     JOIN trust_badges badge ON badge.id = assignment.badge_id
  WHERE specialist.status = 'published'::profile_status AND badge.is_active = true AND badge.code <> 'verified'::text;

views.name: public.published_specialist_verification_facts
views.definition:
SELECT verification.specialist_id,
    verification.identity_checked,
    verification.education_checked,
    verification.experience_checked,
    verification.qualifications_checked,
    verification.references_checked,
    verification.sources_checked,
    verification.checked_at
   FROM verifications verification
     JOIN specialists specialist ON specialist.id = verification.specialist_id
  WHERE specialist.status = 'published'::profile_status AND verification.checked_at IS NOT NULL AND (verification.identity_checked OR verification.education_checked OR verification.experience_checked OR verification.qualifications_checked OR verification.references_checked);

views.name: public.published_specialists
views.definition:
SELECT specialist.id,
    specialist.slug,
    specialist.full_name,
    specialist.country,
    specialist.city,
    specialist.category_id,
    category.name AS category_name,
    category.slug AS category_slug,
    specialist.additional_category_ids,
    specialist.specialization,
    specialist.service_mode,
    specialist.experience_years,
    specialist.profile_summary,
    specialist.full_description,
    specialist.help_topics,
    specialist.work_offers,
    specialist.avatar_path,
    specialist.published_at
   FROM specialists specialist
     LEFT JOIN categories category ON category.id = specialist.category_id
  WHERE specialist.status = 'published'::profile_status;
